changelog:
Targeted deep technical research Skill initial release:

- Provides structured, in-depth research on vendor-specific technical solutions/products, covering Hardware Breakdown, Software Breakdown, Hardware-Software Co-Design, and Technical Benchmarking.
- Strictly distinguishes between publicly verifiable facts and technical derivations, ensuring clear source attribution in all outputs.
- Implements an interactive onboarding questionnaire for research precision, priority, granularity, terminology explanation, and source preferences.
- Delegates all scraping tasks to web-scraper or playwright-scraper based on page type and dynamic site rules, with robust failure and degradation handling.
- Features a five-step workflow, starting with a reconnaissance phase and user confirmation before proceeding to deep-dive technical analysis.
- Prohibits generalized industry knowledge and marketing language, focusing solely on objective, structured technical breakdowns.
